caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chair with a rounded backrest and six vertical rods connecting the backrest to the seat. The seat is flat, rectangular, and made of wood with visible wood grain and some cracks. Four legs support the chair, with two legs at the front and two legs at the back, all angled outward and slightly uneven in length, with a single horizontal stretcher connecting the two side legs. The wood is illustrated in tones of light to medium gray with subtle brown highlights, giving the impression of aged, weathered wood. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or elements present in the image.
title: Handmade Arm Chair
